title: Independent calibrated two-sided trend with real historical depth

independence.selection_rule: No 0019 parameter, exit, threshold or result may be changed or relabeled. Any material change to this preregistration requires a new experiment ID and a new preregistration commit.

development_window.purpose: Development information only, including the downgraded 0019 OOS interval; no promotion claim may use it as independent OOS.

data_policy.point_in_time_rule: Only completed bars, prior labels, prior universe observations and market data received no later than decisionTime may affect a candidate, edge estimate or risk decision.
leakage_controls: Purged forward labels with an embargo at least equal to the label horizon.
Walk-forward model fitting; no final-OOS labels or thresholds may enter development.
Separate development and final-OOS manifests and hashes.
Reject future timestamps, missing receipt times, duplicate events and incomplete market windows.

universe.policy: Point-in-time dynamic universe; reconsider all eligible symbols at each decision boundary.

strategy.candidate_engine: Candidate -> Edge Model -> Net Edge Gate -> Portfolio Risk Gate -> Advisory

regime.SIDEWAYS: NO_TRADE; no candidate may bypass this state

entry.breakout_distance_role: Feature only; never an expected edge or direct PnL estimate.
entry.executable_price: Decision-time bid/ask/depth execution model; no bar open substitution.

exit.policy: A separately preregistered dynamic exit rule must be evaluated causally; no counterfactual exit may enter a promotion metric.
exit.max_hold: Not enabled by this preregistration unless explicitly specified in a new experiment ID.

edge_model.hypothesis: An independently specified, calibrated forward-return edge model plus real historical depth may distinguish executable trend candidates from gross breakout moves after costs.
edge_model.estimator: Causal walk-forward conditional forward-return estimator with uncertainty calibration; exact fit is frozen before the development run.
edge_model.label_policy: Forward executable-price return over the frozen horizon, with purging and no labels whose observation window crosses the decision boundary.
edge_model.trade_rule: Only conservative executable edge after fee, spread, slippage, impact, latency, funding and uncertainty clears every frozen Net Edge and portfolio-risk hurdle may become a PAPER advisory.

costs_and_risk.sizing: Paper-only portfolio risk gate with frozen notional, concentration, event-cluster and drawdown limits; no account or order controls.

validation.method: Walk-forward with purged labels and an embargo; development and final OOS are separate locked datasets.
validation.primary_objective: Net risk-adjusted expectancy and robustness, not win rate.
validation.counterfactual_policy: Counterfactual exits and alternative thresholds are exploratory annotations only and cannot satisfy any gate or be reported as OOS performance.

stop_rules.development_failure: If any development gate fails, STOP. Do not consume, inspect or optimize against the final OOS window.
stop_rules.data_failure: If real depth, funding, receipt timestamps or point-in-time integrity is incomplete, STOP and do not estimate promotion PnL.
stop_rules.threshold_rescue: Do not lower thresholds, change exits, alter costs or remove breadth/risk gates to create signals.
stop_rules.acceptance: This preregistration commit must be accepted before any HY-EXP-0020 data lock, backtest or OOS evaluation.
